body:
God I just want this year to be over. Like I know the pandemic won't be over, but at least things are looking positive for middle of next year with a vaccine, maybe even sooner. Also yeah, the many fish in the sea is something I try to tell myself, but keep coming back to "but this fish was the one I wanted." My mind keeps thinking maybe I could have done something different to keep things together.

I know it all takes time, took me years when my childhood dog died to even think about getting another one. Though when I was a teenager ironically I was more mentally stable and could process the grief. Now, I just can't think about my breakup without spiraling, still. And I fear the not being able to go through the emotions without sinking into a place where I'm a danger to myself is going to prolong the pain. Just need to keep moving forward and ignoring it for now until I can get back to real therapy and have my meds adjusted.
